sources.read_locator: Read the complete relevant setup and proof. Assumption A1 states an unbiased stochastic first-order oracle with bounded second moment of the centered direction; the proof applies the L-smooth quadratic bound, expands the update in gradient plus centered noise, sums and lower-bounds the objective, cancels the noise cross term by conditioning on the history, and converts the weighted sum using the chosen output probabilities. Corollary 2.2 uses the constant stepsize min{1/L, D-tilde/(sigma sqrt(N)}; setting D-tilde=D_f yields the stated O(N^-1+N^-1/2) rate.
